title: Le sport, lundi 14 septembre

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Le sport de ce lundi quatorze septembre.
turns.en: The sport on this Monday the fourteenth of September.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Au programme, du football, et d'abord une nomination.
turns.en: Coming up, football, and first of all an appointment.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: L'Argentin Marcelo Gallardo a été nommé sélectionneur de l'Équateur.
turns.en: «Marcelo Gallardo» of Argentina has been named head coach of Ecuador.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Le nouveau sélectionneur a cinquante ans.
turns.en: The new head coach is fifty.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Il avait auparavant dirigé River Plate.
turns.en: He was previously the coach at «River Plate».

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Il succède à son compatriote Sebastian Beccacece.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: les différents prétendants ont lancé leur campagne.
turns.en: where the various contenders have begun their campaigns.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Après Kylian Mbappé la semaine dernière,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Lamine Yamal s'est positionné à son tour.
turns.en: «Lamine Yamal» has now put his own case.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Dans un entretien donné à Movistar Plus Deportes,
turns.en: In an interview given to «Movistar Plus Deportes»,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: il a longuement parlé du trophée.
turns.en: he talked at length about the trophy.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Il y a cité Kylian Mbappé parmi ses concurrents,
turns.en: He named «Kylian Mbappé» among his rivals,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.en: and made a point of praising him.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Ousmane Dembélé a répondu, lui, à l'entretien donné par Kylian Mbappé à France Football.
turns.en: «Ousmane Dembélé», meanwhile, has answered the interview «Kylian Mbappé» gave to «France Football».

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: il n'a jamais été vu comme l'élu.
turns.en: he has never been seen as the chosen one.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.en: And that is the sport for this Monday morning.

headline_en: Marcelo Gallardo named head coach of Ecuador
summary_en: Marcelo Gallardo named head coach of Ecuador
The Ballon d'Or contenders begin their campaigns
